summary: A Web Component rich-text editor built on TipTap/ProseMirror that integrates with Barkpark's portable-doc block model. Each block gets its own editor instance; edits are serialized to portable-doc patch ops and emitted via CustomEvents to the LiveView host.

intentions.title: Provide premium per-block rich-text editing inside LiveView Studio
intentions.evidence: index.js: BpPaperEditor Web Component — one TipTap instance per block, debounced patch-block op emission via bp-op CustomEvent; wires into the Studio's block-list without owning it

intentions.title: Maintain a faithful round-trip between portable-doc format and TipTap JSON
intentions.evidence: convert.js: blockToTiptap / tiptapToBlock / buildPatchBlockOp cover heading/paragraph/list blocks and all inline marks (bold, italic, code, link); __smoke.mjs verifies the round-trip in plain Node

intentions.title: Offer a Notion-style slash-command block-insert experience
intentions.evidence: slash-menu.js: SlashMenu popup anchored to the caret, keyboard-navigable, groups matching studio_live.ex add-block dropdown; bp-slash-insert CustomEvent hands off to the server to create the new block

intentions.title: Surface schema-aware 'EXPECTED' fields at the top of the slash menu
intentions.evidence: slash-menu.js readExpectedItems / fieldAtCapLive: reads [data-expected-fields] from the DOM, hides fields already at their cap, prepends an EXPECTED group with bound fieldName for the WC to dispatch

intentions.title: Keep the editor fully decoupled from LiveView's render cycle
intentions.evidence: index.js uses CustomEvents (bubbles+composed) for all mutations; slash-menu.js is a standalone popup with no TipTap suggestion plugin dependency; format-bubble.js is hand-rolled without tippy — the WC integrates via the DOM event bus, not LiveView hooks
